system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: python-api
  type: gcp-types/run-v1:projects.locations.services
  properties:
    location: us-central1
    serviceId: python-api
    service:
      apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
      kind: Service
      metadata:
        name: python-api
        annotations:
          run.googleapis.com/ingress: internal-and-cloud-load-balancing
      spec:
        template:
          metadata:
            annotations:
              autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: '1'
              autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: '20'
              run.googleapis.com/execution-environment: gen2
              run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling: 'true'
              run.googleapis.com/startup-cpu-boost: 'true'
          spec:
            containers:
            - image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT_ID/REPO/python-api:latest
              env:
              - name: ENV
                value: production
              - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
                value: '1'
              resources:
                limits:
                  cpu: '1'
                  memory: 512Mi
            containerConcurrency: 50
            timeoutSeconds: 300
        traffic:
        - latestRevision: true
          percent: 100
outputs:
- name: serviceUrl
  value: $(ref.python-api.status.url)
